national_target_after_bridge: internal model target via final rake

architecture.formula: R_internal=(internal_local/internal_weighted_national); R_external=(external_local/external_weighted_national); R_blend=R_internal^(1-s)*R_external^s; local=internal_target*R_blend; normalize seat; rake to internal target

endpoint_semantics.strength_1: pure external relative MRP geography with internal national target

architecture.external_topline_weighting: pre-score-election constituency weights: 2017 for 2019; notional-2019 for 2024; 2024 for live 2026
architecture.live_formula: YouGov2024_relative_geography * clip(MiC2026_relative / MiC2024_relative); then same selected strength and final internal-target rake

promotion_policy: Never auto-promote. Passing the research gate only nominates the method for review and a fresh external validation.
